description:
Install A252's screened eight-unit threshold reader with native allocation.

The allocator is the unchanged A233 conditional-feature construction. All
local guards must pass; this compiler introduces no exploratory override.

extra.allocation_policy: Exact conditional one-unit post-RMS cost; each removed group ranks its own full conditional predictors; independent original-feature fits
extra.local_screen_policy: Exploratory arithmetic quantization tradeoff: native-branch proxy<1.5times baseline, paired-state/direction proxies<1.1times baseline, current A-register bound<0.25digit, all gates saturated and edit/weight limits satisfied
extra.gain_fit: One closed-form ordinary-output gain solve against original same-input HOST native outputs after the original-feature reconstruction; programme output gains fixed; no candidate-residual refitting
extra.native_format_bound: At derived recorded-mixture states, |GELU(g)*up|<=|g|*|up|, followed by triangle bounds on raw RMS and each A-register output

trials.format_bound_scope: Conservative native-feature interval bound at factual-mixture-derived current format states; complete new trajectory still requires full scoring
